text: Thus saith{H559} Jehovah,{H3068} Keep{H8104} ye justice,{H4941} and do{H6213} righteousness;{H6666} for my salvation{H3444} is near{H7138} to come,{H935} and my righteousness{H6666} to be revealed.{H1540}
